bell.definition: A hollow object that makes a ringing sound.
bell.example: The school bell rang at eight o'clock.

bike.definition: A bicycle with two wheels that you ride by pedaling.
bike.example: Mia rides her bike to the park.

boat.definition: A small vehicle used for traveling on water.
boat.example: We crossed the lake in a small boat.

book.definition: A set of written or printed pages bound together.
book.example: He borrowed a book from the library.

cage.definition: A container made of bars or wire for keeping an animal inside.
cage.example: The bird flew out of its cage.

coat.definition: A warm piece of clothing worn over other clothes.
coat.example: Put on your coat because it is cold outside.

cold.definition: Having a low temperature; not warm or hot.
cold.example: The water in the pool was very cold.

cook.definition: To prepare food by heating it.
cook.example: My father likes to cook dinner on Sundays.

corn.definition: A tall plant that produces yellow kernels that can be eaten.
corn.example: We ate grilled corn at the picnic.

door.definition: A movable panel used to enter or leave a room or building.
door.example: Please close the door behind you.

duck.definition: A water bird with a broad bill and webbed feet.
duck.example: A duck swam across the pond.

face.definition: The front part of the head, where the eyes, nose, and mouth are.
face.example: She washed her face before breakfast.

farm.definition: An area of land used for growing crops or raising animals.
farm.example: My grandparents keep chickens on their farm.

food.definition: Things that people or animals eat for energy and growth.
food.example: We packed enough food for the trip.

foot.definition: The part at the end of your leg that you stand and walk on.
foot.example: He hurt his foot while playing soccer.

four.definition: The number that comes after three and before five.
four.example: There are four chairs around the table.

frog.definition: A small animal with long back legs that lives on land and in water.
frog.example: A green frog jumped into the pond.

hair.definition: The strands that grow from the skin, especially on the head.
hair.example: Her hair was wet after swimming.

hand.definition: The body part at the end of your arm, with fingers and a thumb.
hand.example: Raise your hand if you know the answer.

hen.example: The hen laid an egg this morning.

home.definition: The place where a person lives.
home.example: We went home after the movie.

kind.definition: Friendly, caring, and helpful toward others.
kind.example: It was kind of you to help your classmate.

king.definition: A male ruler of a kingdom.
king.example: The king lived in a large castle.

kite.definition: A light frame covered with material that is flown in the wind on a string.
kite.example: The children flew a kite at the beach.

lake.definition: A large area of water surrounded by land.
lake.example: We went fishing at the lake.

lamp.example: I turned on the lamp to read my book.

milk.definition: A white liquid produced by mammals and commonly used as a drink.
milk.example: She poured milk into her cereal.

moon.definition: The natural object that moves around Earth and can be seen in the night sky.
moon.example: The full moon looked bright tonight.

name.definition: A word used to identify a person, place, or thing.
name.example: Please write your name at the top of the page.

nose.definition: The part of the face used for smelling and breathing.
nose.example: The clown wore a red nose.

park.definition: A public outdoor area with grass, trees, or places to play.
park.example: We had lunch in the park.

rain.definition: Water that falls from clouds in drops.

rice.definition: Small grains from a plant that are cooked and eaten as food.
rice.example: We had chicken and rice for lunch.

room.definition: A part of a building separated by walls.
room.example: My room has a desk near the window.

sand.definition: Tiny grains of rock found on beaches and in deserts.
sand.example: The children built a castle in the sand.

six.definition: The number that comes after five and before seven.
six.example: There are six apples in the basket.

sky.definition: The space above Earth that we see when we look upward.
sky.example: The sky was clear and blue.

snow.definition: Soft white pieces of frozen water that fall from clouds.
snow.example: The children played in the snow.

song.definition: A piece of music with words that are sung.

ten.definition: The number that comes after nine.
ten.example: She counted ten stars in the picture.

town.definition: A place where people live that is smaller than a city.
town.example: Their town has a small train station.
